name: Bungle in the Jungle
summary: In Gadgetzan, Alchemist Pestlezugg studies the silithid and likens them to bees. He believes their queen is the weak point, and needs scent and soil from Un'Goro Crater to the west.

sections.title: A Lure for the Queen
sections.body: Alchemist Pestlezugg likens the silithid to bees. He believes that if their queen is destroyed, the rest will fall into disarray. A lure can draw her out. You are to bring her down when she appears.

sections.title: Reagents from Un'Goro
sections.body: To make the lure, Pestlezugg needs reagents from Un'Goro Crater. The silithid hive lies west of Gadgetzan. He asks you to bring an undamaged scent gland from one of the bugs and five samples of the native soil.

faq.q: Who asks for the scent gland and soil, and where?
aliases: who gives bungle in the jungle
faq.answer: Alchemist Pestlezugg asks for them in Gadgetzan.

faq.q: What does Pestlezugg need for the lure?
faq.answer: Pestlezugg needs one undamaged Gorishi scent gland from a silithid bug and five samples of native Un'Goro soil.

aliases: where to find gorishi scent gland
faq.answer: The silithid hive is in Un'Goro Crater, west of Gadgetzan.

faq.q: Why does Pestlezugg want to bring out the hive queen?
faq.answer: Pestlezugg likens the silithid to bees and believes that without their queen, the rest will fall into disarray.
